title: A variational approach to Ornstein-Uhlenbeck evolution equations and obstacle problems
summary: We develop a variational formulation of the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck evolution equation based on a Gaussian divergence structure, in which the drift term is absorbed into the first variation of a weighted Dirichlet energy rather than treated as a lower-order perturbation. For the linear equation, the distributional, energy weak, and variational notions of solution coincide and determine the same unique solution. The same framework yields a variational formulation of the associated parabolic obstacle problem, for which we prove existence and then uniqueness under a standard additional regularity…
